messages:
Elena: Heads-up — prepping a short micro-QBR for TerraSense tomorrow. Main ask: surface token surge, proposed throttles, and enablement gaps. Anyone have a quick burn forecast?
Ravi: Pulling numbers now, give me 5. noticed a 3x increase in embeddings last 48h.
Jonah: Their onboarding scripts started batching bigger prompts after the SDK change on Tuesday. Could explain embedding jump.
Priya: FYI they asked for an enablement session last week — we promised examples for batching/streaming. Haven't delivered the follow-up doc yet.
Elena: Ok. Priority: 1) forecast for QBR one-pager, 2) short mitigation list (throttles/caching), 3) enablement ask & delivery timeline, 4) feedback notes to pass to Product.
Ravi: Quick numbers: ran a 7-day trend query — avg tokens/day = 1.2M, peak day = 4.1M. If current cadence holds, monthly burn ~36M tokens.
Ravi: (query) ```SELECT date, sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE account = 'terrasense' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 7;```
Jonah: Thanks. On SDK change: they enabled auto-batch=true and increased seq_len param. I can patch a sample showing smaller max_seq and chunking.
Priya: I'll own the enablement doc and demo. Can deliver a 10-min recording + a 1-pager checklist by EOD today.
Elena: Great. For mitigations, suggest: 1) set default max_seq to 512 in their config, 2) enable prefix caching for common prompts, 3) soft rate-limit by user role for spikes.
Jonah: Also propose switching their embeddings route to the v2 model variant (quantized) for lower cost — quality delta small for their use-case.
Ravi: Cost impact estimate: moving embeddings to v2 reduces per-embed cost ~40%. If 70% of their tokens are embeddings, that cuts projected monthly spend to ~21M tokens equivalent.
Priya: We'll need a canary plan. I can outline rollback steps in the doc.
Elena: Can someone summarize the action items for QBR slide? 3 bullets + recommended ask for renewal conversation.
Jonah: Slide bullets: 1) Recent spike & root cause (SDK batching + seq_len), 2) Quick wins (config + model switch + caching), 3) Enablement deliverables + timeline.
Ravi: Add a simple chart: 7-day tokens with annotations on SDK deploy time. I'll export PNG and drop into the doc.
Priya: Feedback capture: I'll include 3 open questions for them — why increased batch size, which flows are critical, and acceptance criteria for quality after model change.
Elena: Great. For renewal risk — does this spike meaningfully increase friction? If we don't offer immediate fixes, they might flag cost as reason to downscale. Recommend proposing a 30-day cost review checkpoint in renewal conversation.
Ravi: Agreed. I'll compute run-rate scenarios: conservative/likely/worst and add a recommended short-term credit or promo to soften the hit.
Jonah: Technical note: include a snippet they can drop in to limit sequence lengths: ```client.defaults.max_seq = 512;```
CS-Bot: Reminder — TerraSense has a billing alert threshold at 25M tokens/month. Current projection crosses that in the likely scenario.
Elena: Perfect — that's the trigger to propose a dedicated follow-up. Can we wrap this into a one-pager by 10:30am tomorrow? QBR starts at 11:00.
Ravi: I'll have the scenario table and chart by 9:30.
Pria: (typo) Priya: I will deliver the enablement assets by 10:00 and paste links here.
Elena: Typo noted — thanks. Once docs are in, I'll assemble the slide and add a short speaking script for the CSM to use on the call.
Jonah: Quick sanity check: after suggested changes, we should monitor embeddings quality via our eval rig — I'll set up a 24h perf run.
Priya: I'll capture customer feedback live during the call and post a short action list after.
Elena: Closing checklist: Ravi — numbers & chart; Jonah — patch snippet + eval run; Priya — enablement assets + feedback questions; Elena — assemble slide + script.
CS-Bot: Logged action items to CS tracker: #CS-7129 (TerraSense micro-QBR).
Elena: Thanks team. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Priya: Dropping the 1-pager link here once ready.
Ravi: Chart uploaded to the drive: https://drive.redwood/terrasense/qbr/chart.png
Jonah: Patch snippet posted in repo PR #842 (internal).
Elena: Awesome — see you on the QBR call.
